preconditions.description: The input list must contain exactly two bear colors.

preconditions.expression: all(bear in {'black', 'brown', 'white', 'yellow', 'magenta'} for bear in bears)
preconditions.description: Each bear color in the input must be one of the given valid colors (including invalid ones for 'unknown').

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'black' if bears == ['black', 'black'] else return_value == 'brown' if bears == ['brown', 'brown'] else return_value == 'white' if bears == ['white', 'white'] else return_value == 'dark brown' if {'black', 'brown'} == set(bears) else return_value == 'grey' if {'black', 'white'} == set(bears) else return_value == 'light brown' if {'brown', 'white'} == set(bears) else return_value == 'unknown'
postconditions.description: The output is determined by the combination of the two bear colors: 'black' for two black bears, 'brown' for two brown bears, 'white' for two white bears, 'dark brown' for one black and one brown bear, 'grey' for one black and one white bear, 'light brown' for one brown and one white bear, and 'unknown' for any other combination.
